P7440.corridor_notes: 国家管网集团广东省天然气管网穗莞干线项目（重新报批）：起于广东省天然气管网一期管道工程广州增城分输站，途经广州市增城区、东莞市高埗镇，止于东莞市高埗镇高埗末站；重新报批后线路全长15.88公里（广州段14.80公里，东莞段1.08公里），比原2022年批复方案有调整（水源保护区穿越方式变更）。
P7440.researcher_notes: Guangdong provincial ecology & environment dept (gdee.gd.gov.cn) re-approval notice confirms GEM's StartLocation/EndLocation-equivalent station names verbatim. Length in the notice (15.88km revised) differs modestly from GEM's LengthMergedKm (16.40km) — likely an earlier design-length vs. the revised as-approved length; flagging for awareness, not correcting (route length, not endpoint identity, is affected).
